_comment: Machine-readable extract of Choi, Lee et al. 2020 (Cell Stem Cell), roadmap paper 2, Gate 1. Marker sets and claims were first read from the Europe PMC full-text XML on 2026-09-13 (the PMC web rendering strips italicised gene symbols) and extended on 2026-09-15 from the PDF, at the owner's direction after the owner read the paper. Nothing here is a result of this repository.

citation.authors: Choi J, Park J-E, Tsagkogeorga G, Yanagita M, Koo B-K, Han N, Lee J-H
citation.title: Inflammatory signals induce AT2 cell-derived damage-associated transient progenitors that mediate alveolar regeneration

roadmap.role: biological spine: IL-1beta and HIF1alpha drive the AT2 to DATP to AT1 transition; chronic inflammation can stall regeneration
roadmap.why_it_matters_here: it defines the DATP state that roadmap paper 5 carries into tumour initiation, and its first author leads the owner's own laboratory

injury_model.injury: bleomycin 1.25 U/kg intratracheal, against PBS as the homeostatic control
injury_model.sort_for_non_lineage_libraries: EpCAM-positive Tomato-negative and EpCAM-negative cells combined 2:1, from the same experiments

states_resolved.figure: Figure 1B (in vivo, 12,086 cells) and Figure 2F (organoids, 1,286 control and 2,584 IL-1beta epithelial cells)
states_resolved.note: the same five states are reported in the in vivo lineage-labelled data and in the organoid data

pAT2_inflammatory_UP: Lcn1 (as printed; Lcn2 is the plausible reading, both are reported and neither is used in the rule)
marker_sets.DATP_negative_condition_note: DATPs share the AT1-lineage signature but carry much lower canonical AT1 markers; the low condition is part of the definition, not an afterthought

their_pipeline.cell_filter: more than 500 and fewer than 7,000 detected genes, more than 2,000 UMI
their_pipeline.clustering_and_markers: scanpy 1.3.6 default normalisation, HVG, log, PCA, neighbourhood graph, Louvain; Seurat v2.0 also cited
their_pipeline.contaminant_removal: in vivo: 255 of 12,514 captured cells removed (214 ciliated, 16 mesenchyme, 25 immune) by an initial unsupervised round; organoids: the EpCAM-negative stromal cluster removed; non-lineage libraries: an EpCAM-positive CD45-positive doublet cluster of 1,125 of 14,017 cells removed
their_pipeline.doublets: Scrublet per sample, sim_doublet_ratio 2, n_neighbors 30, expected_doublet_rate 0.1, score above 0.7 flagged; over-clustering at Louvain resolution 20 with cluster mean above 0.6 flagged; remaining clusters checked by prior-knowledge marker conflicts and higher UMI
their_pipeline.trajectory: k-nearest neighbours recomputed at k = 15, PAGA for topology, diffusion pseudotime with default parameters, cycling cells excluded from pseudotime
their_pipeline.atac: MACS2 callpeak, bdgdiff cutoff 10, HOMER motifs; 5 mice pooled for Il1r1-positive AT2, 1 mouse for bulk AT2, two biological samples
their_pipeline.imaging: ImageJ on Leica TCS SP5 confocal sections, at least five sections and ten alveolar regions from three mice per group; dots are sections
their_pipeline.statistics: two-tailed unpaired or paired Student's t test in Prism 7

cascade_as_stated: bleomycin expands interstitial macrophages at day 7 while alveolar macrophages fall; both return to homeostatic levels by day 28
interstitial-macrophage-derived IL-1beta acts on the Il1r1-expressing subset of AT2 cells
those cells lose AT2 identity and become primed AT2 cells; the priming signature rises during the S to G2/M transition of cycling AT2 cells, where Il1r1 is also up
primed AT2 cells convert into DATPs
the conversion runs through HIF1alpha-driven glycolysis, and blocking it (digoxin, 2-DG, Hif1a deletion) blocks DATP generation and AT1 differentiation
DATPs differentiate into mature AT1 cells, established by lineage tracing (Ndrg1 and Krt8 drivers), and can also revert to AT2
persistent IL-1beta prevents AT1 maturation (late markers Aqp5, Vegfa, Cav1, Spock2 stay low), DATPs accumulate, and regeneration is impaired; withdrawal or 2-DG rescues maturation
KRT8-positive CLDN4-positive DATP-like cells are seen in IPF and lung adenocarcinoma tissue, and the IPF KRT17-positive population shares the DATP signature (Figure S7H)

evidence_class_per_link.the five states exist and are distinguis: scRNA-seq; reusable from the deposit (trial D2, D5)
evidence_class_per_link.DATPs sit between primed AT2 and AT1 in: PAGA plus diffusion pseudotime; reusable, and needs no replication because it is an ordering inside a library (trial D3)
evidence_class_per_link.composition changes across PBS, day 14,: scRNA-seq, one library per time point; direction only (trials D2, D4)
evidence_class_per_link.DATP programmes p53, arrest, hypoxia, in: scRNA-seq gene ontology and heatmaps; reusable (trial D6)
evidence_class_per_link.IL-1beta raises primed and DATP fraction: organoid scRNA-seq, one library per treatment; direction only (trial D5)
evidence_class_per_link.DATPs derive from AT2 cells: lineage tracing, about 10 percent of labelled cells Krt8-positive at day 14; NOT reusable from transcriptomes
evidence_class_per_link.DATPs become AT1 cells: lineage tracing from Ndrg1 and Krt8 drivers; NOT reusable
evidence_class_per_link.IL-1beta is sufficient and required: organoids, Il1r1 deletion, imaging and flow; the state change is re-derivable, sufficiency and necessity are not
evidence_class_per_link.only Il1r1-positive AT2 cells respond: Il1r1 reporter mice, functional and epigenetic; NOT reusable, and the ATAC deposit cannot help
evidence_class_per_link.HIF1alpha glycolysis is required: extracellular acidification, glucose uptake, digoxin, conditional deletion; the gene expression is re-derivable, the requirement is not
evidence_class_per_link.interstitial macrophages are the IL-1bet: flow cytometry and the non-lineage libraries; partly reusable from the Tomato-negative libraries, not attempted here
evidence_class_per_link.chronic IL-1beta stalls AT1 maturation: prolonged exposure in vivo and in organoids; the marker pattern is re-derivable in the IL-1beta library (trial D5 G5), the causal claim is not
evidence_class_per_link.Il1r1 rises in G2/M-phase cycling AT2 ce: scRNA-seq with a cell-cycle phase assignment (Figure S5G); not attempted, because phase assignment needs an external gene list this repository would take from memory

deposited_data.design: three time points (PBS, day 14, day 28) by two sorts (Tomato-positive lineage-labelled, Tomato-negative)
deposited_data.replication: none; one library per condition, two mice pooled per library
deposited_data.does_not_support: any tested contrast between time points

deposited_data.supports: the direction of the state change under IL-1beta

deposited_data.libraries: 2 files deposited as bigwig coverage tracks only
deposited_data.supports: almost nothing; coverage carries neither peaks nor reads
deposited_data.does_not_support: re-derivation of the epigenetic claim without going to SRA for raw reads

constraints_carried_into_this_repository: One library per condition in both single-cell accessions, so no transcriptomic contrast here carries within-group replication. Directions are describable; nothing between conditions is testable; no P value is admissible on a between-condition comparison.
Trajectory ordering is the exception: an ordering inside a single library does not need between-group replication, so the AT2 to primed AT2 to DATP to AT1 sequence is genuinely re-askable.

Six of the eight matrices are raw 10x barcode whitelists; cell calling is this repository's job. Trial D1 applies the paper's own post-Cell-Ranger filter to every barcode rather than reproducing Cell Ranger 2.0.2.

Several imaging quantifications plot one dot per histological section with three to six mice per group. Where the dot is a section the plotted unit is not the animal, and this repository treats sections from one animal as technical replicates.
The ATAC-seq supplementary files are bigwig coverage only, so the epigenetic half of the Il1r1-subset claim cannot be re-derived from the deposit at all.
The DATP definition includes a negative condition (low Pdpn, Hopx, Cav1). A marker score built from the positive genes alone will not separate DATPs from mature AT1 cells.

The primed AT2 state is defined by loss of Etv5, Abca3 and Cebpa rather than by a positive marker, so it cannot be scored the same way as the other states, and a loss can be a detection floor; trial D7 A1 tests that.

Ndrg1 appears in both the DATP marker set and the hypoxia programme, so it cannot be used as independent evidence for both the state and its mechanism; trial D6 P3 takes the hypoxia reading without it.

The Tomato-negative libraries are a within-experiment control worth using: they are the cells the AT2 lineage did not label, from the same experiments and the same dissociation, mixed 2:1 with EpCAM-negative cells.
